blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Mary bit her bottom lip.
exercises.why: As mentioned above, the primary use of the accusative case is to denote the object of a verb. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 18.  ·  «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.
